$comment: McBylaw closed vocabularies (Spec 68 §6.5; S5). Every value a row, unit, rule or gate may carry comes from here; 'none' is written, never omitted. Versioned: a change bumps `version` and is reviewed. Evaluator-shaped views (building_type_residential, building_type_parent, lot_condition_threshold) are DERIVED from this file by scripts/analysis/bylaw/vocab.mjs evaluatorVocab(), never kept twice.

deleted_slot.meaning: the regulation slot holds no regulation (deleted, repealed by its own terms, or 'does not currently contain a regulation')

definition_not_used.meaning: a Ch.800 definition no in-scope regulation uses, by the declared definitions matcher

non_residential_use_condition.meaning: a condition on a non-residential or institutional use, not on a dwelling

apartment_building_only.meaning: applies only to apartment buildings (MaxBLD scope: detached / semi / row / houseplex)

apartment_amenity_or_waste.meaning: apartment-building amenity space or waste storage

home_occupation_use.meaning: regulates a home occupation use, not the building or lot

non_residential_zone_parking.meaning: parking, loading or bicycle rules for a non-residential zone category

unzoned_or_city_service.meaning: unzoned land, vehicle habitation, satellite dishes or city services

parking_aisle_or_marking.meaning: drive aisles, aisle reductions or markings of a parking area, not a residential lot's parking

administrative_no_application_effect.meaning: pure administration with no effect on what may be built on a lot (Spec 69 M-31)

other_zone_category.meaning: governs a zone category outside the Residential Zone category (vocab.zone); adopted by Spec 69 M-56

rule_kind.mechanical: decided by a declared pattern with no judgment; applies automatically
rule_kind.page_status: decided by the page's ruled status in page-set.json (retired pages, Spec 69 M-47 S3 note)
rule_kind.judgment: needs evidence and an operator ruling (`--accept --ruling=<id>`); until ruled, its rows are `awaiting_ruling`, counted
rule_kind.page_scope: the in-scope default for a pinned page, from its page-set basis

page_rule_reason.other_zone_category: the entry governs a zone category outside the Residential Zone category (vocab.zone)
page_rule_reason.non_residential_use_condition: the entry regulates a non-residential use only
page_rule_reason.zone_labels_from_dataset: map rule: zone labels are read from the zoning dataset (Spec 69 M-42), not from the map page
page_rule_reason.phase2_exception_pages: Ch.900 residential exception pages, pinned at Phase 2 entry (Spec 69 M-15 v0.5 note)
page_rule_reason.phase2_overlay_geometry: a map-area overlay pinned in Phase 2 with its overlay geometry (Spec 69 M-37 S3 note, M-41)
page_rule_reason.deferred_by_ruling: left open by a named ruling (counted until ruled)
page_rule_reason.chapter_empty: the chapter page holds no regulations (recorded empty)

required_lot_area_m2.concept: required minimum lot area (label a, or the zone's stated value)

required_lot_frontage_m.concept: required minimum lot frontage (label f, or the zone's stated value); also read by band conditions

lot_coverage_pct.concept: maximum lot coverage, percent of the lot area, of the buildings the unit applies to

fsi.concept: maximum floor space index (gross floor area / lot area)

gfa_m2.concept: maximum gross floor area of the building the unit applies to

interior_floor_area_m2.concept: maximum (or minimum) interior floor area of the building, suite or room the unit applies to

height_m.concept: maximum height of the building the unit applies to, from established grade

main_wall_height_m.concept: maximum height of the exterior portion of main walls

entrance_height_m.concept: maximum elevation of the main pedestrian entrance (or first floor) above established grade

building_width_m.concept: maximum (or minimum) width of the building the unit applies to

side_setback_m.concept: minimum side yard setback (a side lot line not abutting a street)

side_setback_street_m.concept: minimum setback from a side lot line abutting a street (flankage)
patterns: side lot line that abuts a street

street_setback_m.concept: minimum building setback from any lot line abutting a street
patterns: lot line that abuts a street

lane_setback_m.concept: minimum building setback from a lot line abutting a lane

lot_line_setback_m.concept: minimum building setback from a lot line where the clause does not name a yard (ancillary buildings, suites, pools)

separation_m.concept: minimum separation distance between buildings (or main walls) on the same lot

encroachment_m.concept: maximum distance a building element may encroach into a required setback

encroachment_clearance_m.concept: minimum distance an encroaching element must keep from a lot line

platform_area_m2.concept: maximum area of a deck, balcony or platform

platform_height_m.concept: maximum height of a platform above established grade

element_width_pct.concept: maximum share of a wall's width taken by an element (dormers, bay windows)

element_width_m.concept: maximum width of a projecting element (dormer, bay window, porch, stairs)

front_landscaping_pct.concept: minimum share of the front yard that is landscaping

front_soft_landscaping_pct.concept: minimum share of the front yard landscaping that is soft landscaping

rear_soft_landscaping_pct.concept: minimum share of the rear yard that is soft landscaping

side_street_landscaping_pct.concept: minimum share of a side yard abutting a street that is landscaping
patterns: side yard abutting a street for landscaping

landscaping_strip_width_m.concept: minimum width of a landscaping or soft-landscaping strip

dwelling_units_max.concept: maximum number of dwelling units in the building or on the lot

buildings_on_lot.concept: maximum number of buildings of a stated type on a lot

garage_entrance_setback_m.concept: minimum setback of a vehicle entrance to a garage from a street or lane lot line

parking_spaces.concept: minimum or maximum number of parking spaces (a count, Spec 68 §6 'a count is a target in units')

parking_rate.concept: minimum or maximum parking spaces per dwelling unit (or per stated base)

parking_space_length_m.concept: minimum length of a parking space

parking_space_width_m.concept: minimum width of a parking space or drive aisle

vertical_clearance_m.concept: minimum vertical clearance of a parking, loading or bicycle space

bicycle_parking_spaces.concept: minimum number of bicycle parking spaces

bicycle_parking_rate.concept: minimum bicycle parking spaces per dwelling unit (or per stated base)

frontage_measurement_offset_m.concept: the distance back from the front lot line at which a measurement (lot frontage) is taken

averaging_distance_m.concept: the distance within which abutting buildings are counted for front-yard averaging

lot_area_per_unit_min_m2.concept: required minimum lot area for each dwelling unit (label au)
patterns: lot area for each dwelling unit

lot_frontage_m.note: MEASURED lot frontage (not the label f requirement, which is the target required_lot_frontage_m)

proposed_height_m.note: height of the building the unit applies to, measured from established grade (a scenario value)

abutting_front_setback_m.note: front yard setback of the abutting building(s), for front-yard averaging

parking_width_m.note: the width of a parking space is set by 200.5.1.10, not a Ch.800 definition (800.50(540) defines only the use of the area)

distance_to_residential_m.note: distance from an ancillary building or suite to the residential building on the lot (a scenario value)

dwelling_units.note: a count (user input unit_count), not a measured quantity

house_units.note: residential units in the detached / semi-detached house or rowhouse (O. Reg. 299/19 scope, Spec 69 M-55; a scenario value, user input house_units)

ancillary_units.note: residential units in buildings ancillary to the house (O. Reg. 299/19 scope, Spec 69 M-55; a scenario value, user input ancillary_units)

d.meaning: zone floor space index (Spec 69 M-42: a residential label's d is the zone FSI)

au.meaning: required minimum lot area per dwelling unit (10.5.1.10(3)(C); RM apartment buildings)

parcel_of_urban_residential_land.meaning: O. Reg. 299/19 / Planning Act s.35.1: a parcel of urban residential land (provincial scope, Spec 69 M-55); a lot input, never assumed

provincial_scope.$comment: How a provincial unit's external.json scope (Spec 68 §6.1) maps to lot inputs (Spec 69 M-55 + notes 2026-10-07; M-60). Every provincial term is mapped explicitly; an unmapped term is a provincialUnits() violation. building_type: the 569-2013 types a provincial principal building type names (rowhouse = 569-2013 townhouse, 800.50(865)); a conditional entry (operator ruling (b) 2026-10-07) maps a houseplex type and its listed children only while the lot's house + ancillary units are ≤ max_lot_units — neither the Planning Act nor O. Reg. 299/19 defines the building types, so the mapping is inferred from City staff statements (cited) and flagged for the M-29 expert sample; a 4–6-plex never maps. land (operator ruling (c) 2026-10-07): an explicit lot flag wins; else a declared citywide default, except parcels on the cited exclusion list, which are unknown (not_evaluated:missing_input when it matters).

parcel_of_urban_residential_land.citation: Planning Act, R.S.O. 1990, c. P.13, s. 1(1) "parcel of urban residential land" (within an area of settlement, residential use permitted by by-law, served by municipal sewage works and a municipal drinking water system). Citywide default for lots in a 569-2013 residential zone: no primary citywide servicing statement exists (declared, not measured); Toronto Municipal Code Ch. 681 s. 681-11A(4) and Ch. 849 s. 849-14A show unsewered lots exist. Research: .cursor/mcbylaw/research-provincial-scope.md (2026-10-07).

layer3.$comment: McBylaw Layer 3 report-field statuses and reasons (Spec 68 §11.1, Spec 69 M-64; PRE-LOCK FIX 2026-10-07 after the Phase 3 trial K2/K3). Equal to Spec 68 §11.1 in both directions. A parameterised status is written <status>:<param> (a clause, scenario, rule, target, form, field or input). A Layer 2 not_evaluated_reason (the top-level list) propagates unchanged at either level. Consumed by the planned Layer 3 step and the G-SHAPE status arm; no code reads it yet.

derived_unit.m2/unit: Layer 3 report targets only (avg_unit_gfa_sqm): m2 ÷ units; never a literal, dsl_target or Layer 1 unit (Spec 69 M-72 note)

banned_code_refs.reason: STAND_SET: a CR standard-set selector (1/2/3), not metres (Spec 67 KFM-14); never a setback

definitions_matcher.$comment: Links a regulation's text to the Ch.800 terms it uses (Spec 68 §6.4 rule 11, G-READ). Case-insensitive, whole words, the term or its plural (+s / +es; y -> ies); a parenthetical in the term is dropped. Longer terms are matched first and their spans are not re-matched by a shorter term they contain ('Front Yard Setback' does not also count 'Front Yard'). A flip of any definition's used / not-used state changes the pinned universe and needs --accept --ruling.
